FRETBOARD HERO / ABOUT

Built around understanding the fretboard.

Fretboard Hero brings visual fretboard tools and guided practice into one application for guitar, bass and ukulele.

Try this exercise ↗Get it on Google Play

Written by Jean-François Seignemorte · Reviewed 27 October 2026

The project

Fretboard Hero is developed by Jean-François Seignemorte. Its tools focus on notes, pentatonic patterns, triads, chord shapes and daily practice. The guides on this site explain how to use those tools with your instrument.

The guitar guides use standard six-string tuning. They are practical learning resources, not a promise of a particular level or speed of progress.

Availability and feedback

The web application is available at fretboard-hero.com. The guitar Android app is linked on Google Play. Available platforms, store prices and purchase conditions should be checked on the official product listing.

For a question, a correction to a guide or a problem with the application, contact hello@fretboard-hero.com. Include the instrument, screen, device and browser involved so the issue is easier to reproduce.

Privacy and accuracy

Microphone access is used for tuning and supported practice feedback. Audio is processed locally and is not recorded or uploaded by the app. The privacy policy explains data handling, including in-app purchases.

These pages describe the features available when reviewed. Store availability and features can change; the application and official store listing remain the places to check before purchasing.

FRETBOARD HERO

Start with the free demo

The demo lets you explore the key of A, with an A minor Daily Routine and the note A on the Fretboard Map. Learn includes pentatonic positions, triads and chord shapes; the Circle of Fifths is also open. Additional notes and keys require full access. The Android app offers a one-time in-app purchase, with no subscription. Check the app for the current price and purchase terms.

Open the app

Try the web app in your browser or use the Android app. Microphone feedback depends on your browser, device and permission; you can also practice without it. An iOS App Store release is not yet linked from this site.

Keep exploring

Pentatonic scales ↗

Practice A minor pentatonic with an interactive guitar fretboard. Learn the five positions, find root notes and connect patterns with Fretboard Hero.

Fretboard notes ↗

Find notes across the guitar neck with Fretboard Hero. Start with A, use octave landmarks and check your recall with the fretboard quiz.

Triads ↗

Understand major and minor guitar triads with Fretboard Hero. Locate roots, thirds and fifths and practice inversions on groups of three strings.

Daily routine ↗

Build a focused guitar session with Fretboard Hero: root notes, scales, triads, rhythm and pentatonic movement in one key. Try the A minor demo.
